name: @pipeup/inbox
description: Tells people they were mentioned, even on pages they haven't opened: a note sealed so only they can read it, left at an inbox service the page's author names.
author: Pipeup contributors

to: the inbox service the page names (data-pipeup-inbox)
network.says: Only after you switch on Mentions by inbox: when you mention someone, a short note (who, your words, the page's address) is left for them at the page's inbox service, sealed so only they can read it; and your own inbox is checked there. The service sees that a note arrived, its size and when, and your network address, never who it is from or what it says.
